issues.on_page: General Government actual lines sum 1,557,669; TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS printed 6,698,247
issues.issue: Checked as an extraction error and ruled out; the discrepancy is real and correctly recorded. Trimmed p5 (printed p17, original PDF p19) is the whole General Fund schedule: header, receipts, the General Government lines only, then TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS. The next page (p6, printed p18) is the Road/Inheritance schedule, so no page is missing. Nothing was misread: receipts add to the printed 8,950,287, and the 12 non-zero General Government actuals (all captured; the other lines are dashes) add to 1,557,669. The total is not a budget/actual mix-up and includes no transfers (6,698,247 equals the GF TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS on p4). The Budget columns have the same gap: lines add to 1,964,705 against a printed 9,037,695. The missing 5,140,578 equals the GF's other functions on p4 (Public Safety 3,264,111 + Public Works 60,757 + Public Assistance 41,533 + Miscellaneous 1,506,522 + Capital Outlay 267,656 = 5,140,579), less $1 rounding. The printed schedule leaves out those function lines, so GF detail cannot add up to its total. Accept the discrepancy.
GF schedule General Government lines add to 1,557,669; p4 GF General Government prints 1,557,668. $1 rounding difference in the report itself.
Agricultural extension could be agriculture/fair; it is printed under the General Government heading, so general government is defensible (already marked review).

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities general receipts: Health Insurance Settlements 7,350 + Miscellaneous 16,602 = 23,952
